items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 245:1
items.html: Adam HaRishon before the sin included all three worlds BYA, and they are the secret of the six thousand years, in the secret of "six thousand years is the duration of the world," as mentioned above in answer 244. Therefore Adam HaRishon also included, corresponding to them, six thousand degrees of souls. (Item 113).
